about: ZETAPHY Saphan MAINNET: the ZTPHY route ZETAPHY mainnet (3659) <-> Base mainnet (8453), owner decision 2026-11-14. Read by zetaphy-network/scripts/saphan-mainnet.js (plan / deploy / open / pause / agents) and scripts/saphan-pool.js (the Base pools). Public values only: no key, no secret. null = an owner input that is still missing (the plan lists them; deploy refuses while one is missing). Runbook: docs/SAPHAN-MAINNET.md.

NOT 0x833589fCD6eDb6E08f4c7C32D29b5Dd5Ac9F4f8E (that address is not USDC: it differs after ...D4)
sources.checkedOnChain: not from the machine that wrote this file (its network could not reach a Base or ZETAPHY RPC). The saphan-mainnet CI job forks Base mainnet and checks every Base address here has code and answers as expected; `saphan-mainnet.js check` does the same against the live chains [read only].

zetaphy.name: zetaphy
zetaphy.core: registry/chains/zetaphy/addresses.yaml (next to this file; written by the hyperlane CLI at the core step, then committed)

base.name: base
base.ownersAbout: the Base SimpleMultisig (guardian of the synthetic, proposer of the Base timelock). Default: the ZETAPHY guardian multisig's three owners (EOAs: the same keys sign on Base). Owner: confirm, or replace.

validators.about: OUR Hyperlane validators. zetaphyOrigin signs ZETAPHY -> Base messages (the ISM on the Base synthetic). baseOrigin signs Base -> ZETAPHY messages (the ISM on the ZETAPHY vault); mode 'ours' = our validator(s) also validate Base (a second validator process, setup-agents-mainnet.sh VALIDATE_BASE=yes), mode 'hyperlane' = use hyperlaneBaseDefault instead (Hyperlane's published 3-of-5, stronger, no extra process). Addresses come from setup-agents-mainnet.sh addresses on the agents machine.
validators.allowSingleValidatorAbout: a 1-of-1 ISM is refused unless this is true (owner flag): then one key on one machine can mint unbacked ZTPHY on Base (bounded by the caps and the delay).

limits.about: Whole ZTPHY. Big enough for the owner's first liquidity (2 x 1,000,000 ZTPHY in one day), small against the supply (1,000,000,000): at most 0.25% can ever be out. The way back is tighter (a forged release would drain the vault). Raising any of them is a 48 h timelock call; guardians can lower them at once.

deployer.about: a FRESH key used only for this deploy (the same address on ZETAPHY and Base), holding no role afterwards. Owner input: its address; the key stays in a keystore on the owner's machine (KEYFILE / --keystore), never in this repository.

liquidity.about: The owner's first pools on Base (scripts/saphan-pool.js). Amounts are owner inputs (decided 2026-11-14: 1,000,000 ZTPHY + 100 stable per pool, 0.0001 USD per ZTPHY); edit them here.
liquidity.baseRecipientAbout: REQUIRED owner input: a Safe on Base (2 of 3, made at app.safe.global by the liquidity multisig's members) that receives the bridged ZTPHY, holds the USDC/USDT and owns the pool positions. NEVER the ZETAPHY multisig's 0x address: on Base nobody holds its key, coins sent there are lost.

pools.issuer: UNVERIFIED: Tether does not list Base among its issuing chains in any source in this repository. Owner input: the exact token, checked on basescan.org (name, decimals 6, who can mint and freeze it)

costs.about: Inputs of the cost estimate (saphan-mainnet.js costs / plan). Base gas price in gwei (check basescan.org/gastracker before), ETH price only for the USD column.
